title: Clean up remaining Daily Inbox content inconsistencies
objective:
Fix only the concrete product inconsistencies in EVAL-R1-001 through EVAL-R1-006. Keep the Daily Inbox Briefing manual-first and educational. Do not change plan claims, prices, badges, prompts, hero or tile labels, tests, the evaluator, or unrelated copy. Do not commit, push, merge, or deploy. Ignore EVAL-R1-007.

EVAL-R1-001: In content/published/use-cases/ai-daily-inbox-briefing.json, make the public counts match the concept demo. Set experience.outcomes.metrics to value "1" label "urgent item", value "1" label "reply needed", and value "1" label "calendar conflict". Set experience.tile.scenes final scene metrics to value "1" label "urgent", value "1" label "reply", and value "1" label "conflict". Leave the input counts of 18 unread emails and 6 calendar events unchanged. Do not change conceptDemo.summary.

EVAL-R1-002: Replace experience.workflow.note with exactly: "This workflow is designed to summarize, prioritize, and recommend. It does not send emails or modify calendar events. You take those actions yourself. Connected AI tools may request broader permissions during setup, so review them before authorizing."

EVAL-R1-003: Replace the risk "OAuth tokens expire — unattended runs fail silently without monitoring" with "Connector access can expire. If a later run cannot see Gmail or Calendar, reconnect and review the permissions before continuing." Replace "Briefing sent to wrong channel could expose client email content" with "Pasting a briefing into the wrong chat or a shared demo can expose client email content. Review it before you share it." Leave the other two risks unchanged.

EVAL-R1-004: Remove the unsupported 11:00 AM deadline. In the concept-demo Urgent today item, change meta from "Due by 11:00 AM" to "Before the 2:00 PM client review". In the sample Urgent today item, set meta to "Before the 2:00 PM client review", set fact to "The client asked for contract approval before today's 2:00 PM client review.", and set action to "Review the latest contract and decide whether to approve it before that meeting." Do not add a new meeting.

EVAL-R1-005: In the Gemini whereToConnect steps, put permission review before enablement. Use exactly these four steps: "Open Gemini while signed into the Google account that owns your Gmail and Calendar." "Before you enable access, read the permission prompt. Approve only what you understand, and confirm your organization's policy if this is a work account." "Enable or confirm access to Gmail and Calendar where Gemini offers Google app connections." "Ask Gemini to confirm it can see today’s calendar, then paste the Starter Kit prompt." Do not leave a second review step after enablement.

EVAL-R1-006: Shorten the Claude accountNeeded line to exactly "A Claude account that can use connectors for Gmail and Google Calendar." The setup guide already shows the availability note, so do not repeat plan or usage-limit wording in that line. Remove the Claude extra note "Review every permission Claude requests before authorizing." Keep the note about connectors being unavailable. Do not change ChatGPT or Gemini account text, and do not edit components/starter-kit/setup-guide.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: The outcome strip and the tile's final scene show 1 urgent, 1 reply, and 1 conflict, matching the concept-demo summary.
The workflow note does not say unless you explicitly ask, and it says the workflow does not send emails or modify calendar events.
The risks no longer mention unattended runs or a briefing sent to a channel.
No sample or concept-demo item says 11:00 AM. The urgent sample fact names the existing 2:00 PM client review.
The Gemini steps review permissions before enabling access, and they do not review permissions again after that.
The Claude account line does not repeat availability or usage limits, and the Claude notes do not repeat the permission-review step.
Hero and tile demo labels remain Watch demo. Tests, prompts, prices, badges, and the Claude availability note stay unchanged.
